mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, name, key_prefix, key_hash, bound_user_id, allowed_tools, enabled, expires_at, service_token_enc, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: select from crm_mcp_api_key where tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by id asc
